title: Notify queue line
description: One line of .devcontainer/tmp/notify/<sid>.jsonl, appended by the notify-queue hook (hook.js, tail-cancel.js). A line without `v` is today's format and is read as-is; `v` is 1 when present. `hello` is the only event that requires `v`. Every event is closed: a property not listed for it is an error.

sid.description: Claude Code session id (UUID). Also the queue file name.

iso8601.description: ISO-8601 UTC as written by Date#toISOString().

envelope.description: Fields hook.js adds to every notification event. Each is optional because older lines (before v0.2) and tail-cancel.js lines lack them.

notif_id.description: <event>-<sid8>-<epoch ms>; the --id of the banner, used by notif remove and echoed in notif-actions.

session_name.description: Claude Code session title or slug. Absent when no transcript.

launchUrl.description: vscode-remote URL of the container window. Absent before VS Code wrote a history file.

focused.description: Host window focus at the last permission cycle. Absent when unknown.

hello.description: Producer liveness. Written once per SessionStart (startup, resume, clear, compact). Carries no notification envelope.

producer_version.description: The producer's version: the devcontainer-sandbox image version read from /etc/devcontainer-base-version, or "unknown".

last_message_excerpt.description: Recap line or first usable line of the last assistant message, unicode escapes decoded.

notification_type.description: idle_prompt | permission_prompt | elicitation_dialog, or any other value Claude Code emits. Consumers flatten the event into this type and treat unknown values as unmapped.

tool_use_id.description: The VS Code extension's permission requestId (32 hex today), read from pending-perms. Absent when no match; the consumer then shows no Allow button.

tool_input.description: The tool input verbatim. Rendering is the consumer's job.

tool_cancelled.description: Written by tail-cancel.js when the transcript shows the user cancelled a tool use. Today it carries only ts, sid, event.
